info.title: Ameba API
info.description:
Reverse-engineered from the ameba-backend Django REST Framework source (not from a live schema endpoint — drf-yasg's /api/docs/ swagger UI only mounts when settings.DEBUG=True, so it is not available on the production ameba.cat deployment this frontend talks to). Verified directly against api/serializers/*.py, api/views/*.py and api/urls.py in the ameba-backend repo, then cross-checked against how ameba-site actually consumes each endpoint. Treat this file as the source of truth for future frontend work against this API, and re-verify against ameba-backend if either repo has moved on since.

## Global facts that apply to every endpoint below

- **No pagination anywhere.** No DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CLASS is configured; every list endpoint returns a bare JSON array, never a `{count, next, previous, results}` envelope.
- **No server-side filtering/search/ordering.** No django-filter/SearchFilter/OrderingFilter is wired up on any viewset. Query params like `?type=festival` are NOT honored server-side — list endpoints just return their queryset as-is (typically pre-filtered to `is_active=True` and a fixed ordering). All client-side filtering (e.g. Lab vs Festivals by `event.type`) must happen after fetching the full list.
- **Auth is JWT (SimpleJWT)** for the standard `Authorization: Bearer <access>` flow (`token/`, `token/refresh/`), EXCEPT `member_card` (custom signed `?token=` query param, see `memberCardAuth`) and `ticket` (custom signed Bearer token with its own salt, see `eventTicketAuth`) — these two do not accept a normal JWT access token.
- **`type` means something different on almost every resource that has it** — it is not one enum across the API: on `events` it's the event category (`taller`, `concierto`, `mercado`, `charla`, `concurso`, `festival` — `festival` is the sole discriminator the frontend uses to split Festivals from Lab activities); on `member_card` it's a hardcoded literal `"card"`; on `ticket` it's a hardcoded literal `"event"`; on a member's own profile it's the name of their current subscription plan (e.g. `"Standard"`). Don't assume a shared meaning when reading `.type` off a response.
- **`carts`, `subscriptions`, `articles`, `events` all model their purchasable content as `Item` → `ItemVariant`.** Cart mutations always operate on **variant ids**, never item/product ids — `POST`/`PATCH` a cart with `item_variant_ids: [<variant id>, ...]`.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Login, token refresh/logout, registration, activation, password recovery

tags.name: events
tags.description: Lab activities + Festivals (same resource, split client-side by `type === "festival"`)

tags.name: members
tags.description: Authenticated user's own member/project profile, member card, profile images

tags.name: artists
tags.description: Artist/DJ profiles and interviews — not currently consumed by ameba-site (see description)

tags.name: content
tags.description: Covers, collaborators, legal documents, manifesto/about, genres

bearerAuth.description: Standard SimpleJWT access token from POST /token/. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <access>`. The frontend's axios interceptor (src/axios.js) auto-refreshes via POST /token/refresh/ on a 401 with SimpleJWT's `code: "token_not_valid"`.

memberCardAuth.name: token
memberCardAuth.description: Custom signed token (django.core.signing, salt=QR_MEMBER_SALT, signature=(member.pk, member.qr_date)), NOT a JWT. Produced server-side and embedded in the member's QR code. Only valid for GET /member_card/.

eventTicketAuth.description: Custom signed Bearer token (django.core.signing, salt=QR_EVENT_SALT, signature=(user_id, item_variant_id)), NOT a JWT — do not send a normal login access token here. Only valid for GET /ticket/. WARNING: reading this endpoint is side-effecting — the first successful GET marks the ticket as checked in (adds the user to the event's checked_in set) and returns `checked_in: false`; every subsequent read returns `checked_in: true`.

Variant.description: A purchasable variant of an Item (event ticket tier, article size, subscription plan length). Cart mutations reference variants by `id`, never the parent item's id.

item.description: FK id of the parent Item/Event/Article/Subscription

stock.description: -1 is a sentinel meaning unlimited stock

price.description: Decimal serialized as a string, e.g. "12.00"

Variant.x-known-gap: Model field ItemVariant.recurrence (monthly/yearly, used by subscription variants) exists but is NOT exposed here — if you ever need to distinguish monthly vs yearly membership variants in the UI, this field must be added to VariantSerializer server-side first. The frontend does not currently read/need it.

price_range.description: e.g. "12€ / 20€", or "-" if the item has no variants

price.description: Cheapest variant's price, or null if none

stock.description: Aggregate of variant stocks; -1 means unlimited

header.description: Short display title, used in card badges. `name` is the full name.

type.description: The ONLY field distinguishing a Festival from a Lab activity — frontend selector (src/selectors/festivals.js) does `event.type === "festival"` for Festivals, everything else for Lab.

maps_url.description: Frontend treats a maps_url containing the substring "dice" as an external-ticketing-platform enum (see EventDetails.jsx) — a substring check, not a real enum field.

Article.description: List shape for /articles/ (webshop merchandise — NOT editorial articles). Identical fields to ItemList, no extra ones.

Subscription.description: Membership plans. Unusually, the List and Detail serializers expose identical (full) fields — list responses are not trimmed down. The frontend's /memberships page assumes there is exactly one Subscription product and reads membership[0].

SavedEvent.description: GET/POST/DELETE users/current/events/saved/ — the body/response shape for saving an event as a favourite.

event.description: POST body is {"event": <event id>}; `user` is injected server-side from the request. DELETE by the event's item pk at users/current/events/saved/{item_pk}/.

SignedUpEvent.description: users/current/events/signed_up/ reuses the same declared serializer as SavedEvent (field `event`, sourced from `.item`), but its actual queryset is ItemVariant.acquired_by.through, whose real attribute is `.itemvariant` not `.item`. This looks like a backend serializer/model mismatch — verify the ACTUAL runtime response shape before building a frontend feature on this endpoint; nothing in ameba-site currently calls it.

MemberCard.description: GET /member_card/ (memberCardAuth). Despite ListModelMixin, list() is overridden to return a SINGLE object, not an array.

type.description: Always the literal string "card" — not the membership plan name (see Member.type for that).

EventTicket.description: GET /ticket/ (eventTicketAuth). Reading this endpoint is side-effecting — see the eventTicketAuth security scheme description.

first_name.description: null if the user has no member profile

event.description: The event's name (string, not an id)

variants.description: e.g. "Size: M" — only populated if the event has more than one variant, else null

checked_in.description: false on first read (and marks the ticket checked-in as a side effect), true thereafter

CartItem.description: One line item inside carts[].item_variants (read-only, computed). ALL fields are SerializerMethodFields.

discount_value.description: Empty string if no discount, else e.g. "20"

is_subscription.description: Frontend's isMemberCheckout() (src/utils/utils.jsx) checks `item_variants.some(x => x.is_subscription)` to detect a membership-only checkout.

item_variant_ids.description: Writable AND readable (not write_only, not in read_only_fields) — PATCH this to replace the cart's contents entirely (it clears then re-adds). Also present verbatim on every read response as the flat list of current variant ids, in addition to the expanded `item_variants` below.

discount_code.description: Writable — set to a DiscountCode's `code` string to apply it.

needs_checkout.description: Reading this property has a side effect server-side: it calls cart.has_changed(), which saves the cart if its content hash changed.

CartCheckout.description: GET carts/{id}/checkout/ — runs validation only, does not charge.

checkout.description: {} if no Stripe payment_intent exists yet

PaymentData.description: GET carts/{id}/payment/ — creates the Stripe PaymentIntent. NOTE: despite being routed as GET, the view calls serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True) against request.data, which is unusual for GET — verify against real traffic whether a body is actually required/sent.

stripe_public.description: Stripe publishable key, read from settings

file.description: Despite the field name `file`, this is a URL string, not a file upload representation.

Manifest.description: GET /about/ (also aliased at /manifest/). Single most-recent active object, not a list.

Artist.description: Detail shape. NOTE: ameba-site has no reachable consumer of /artists/ today — its only reader, SupportLocals.jsx, is not imported from Home.jsx/App.jsx and itself imports a non-existent file (MainSupportLocals) that would break the build if the component were ever wired back in.

media.description: oEmbed/embed-HTML strings (e.g. YouTube/Spotify embeds), not URLs

InterviewList.description: NOT consumed anywhere in ameba-site currently.

artist.description: Artist's name (string), not an id or object

current_answers.description: Only is_active=True answers, ordered by question position

MemberProjectList.description: GET /member_projects/ — public directory ("Socis"), filtered server-side to Member.public=true.

images.description: Plain URL strings — DIFFERENT shape than MemberDetail.images (which is a list of objects). This is the public-facing serializer; don't assume the same shape as the authenticated members/current/ endpoint.

Membership.description: One entry in Member.memberships[] (a purchased subscription period, distinct from the shop-side Subscription/Variant model).

subscription.description: FK id of the Subscription item

MemberDetail.description: The shape returned by GET users/current/member_profile/, GET/PATCH members/current/ (or members/{any pk}/ — the URL pk is ALWAYS ignored server-side and overridden with request.user's own member; you can never read/write anyone else's profile through this endpoint), and GET users/current/reset_qr/.

type.description: The member's current subscription PLAN NAME (e.g. "Standard") — do NOT confuse with MemberCard.type, which is always the literal "card".

images.description: OBJECTS here (id/image/created/member) — different shape than MemberProjectList.images (plain URL strings). Read via images[i].image, not images[i] directly.

genres.description: Writable — server auto-normalizes each value to upper-snake-case and get_or_creates the MusicGenres row.

public.description: Whether this profile shows up on the public member_projects/ listing.

upload_images.description: Write-only. Accepts a list of base64 data-URIs (or an existing image URL to keep). Saving this REPLACES ALL existing images — it's not additive.

upload_media_urls.description: Write-only, also fully replaces media_urls on save.

username.description: Special-cased server-side: writing this field actually updates the related User.username directly, bypassing normal field assignment.

User.description: GET users/current/ shape (ReadUserSerializer) — all fields read-only here. PATCH via UpdateUserSerializer allows writing username/language (email/date_joined/member stay read-only).

cart_id.description: Optional anonymous cart UUID (from localStorage) to attach and auto-checkout onto the new account.

401.description: Invalid credentials — src/store/services/auth.service.js also treats this as a signal the account may need re-registration confirmation (WrongProvidedCredentials).

post.description: src/axios.js's interceptor calls this automatically on any 401 whose body has code === "token_not_valid", then retries the original request once.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The refresh token to blacklist, embedded in the URL path.

token.description: Signed token (salt=ACTIVATION_SALT, signature=(id, is_active)) from the activation email link.

post.summary: Register + create a member profile + attach/checkout a cart in one call
post.description: Distinct from POST /users/ (plain account) — this creates the User AND the Member profile together, and REQUIRES cart_id to reference a cart that contains at least one subscription item (raises CartNeedOneSubscription otherwise). Not currently called anywhere in ameba-site — worth double-checking whether the actual registration flow should be using this instead of the two-step users/ + member_profile/ calls it does today.

200.description: Always 200 regardless of whether the email exists, deliberately non-revealing.

post.summary: Register a plain account (no member profile)

get.summary: Get a user (use "current" as {id} for the logged-in user)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A numeric pk, or the literal string "current".

get.description: Object-level permission only allows the user themself, or a staff account with the `api.full_user` permission.

404.description: UserHasNotMemberProfile — the user has no Member row yet

post.summary: Create a member profile for the user

get.summary: List events (Lab activities + Festivals, undifferentiated server-side)
get.description: Filters to is_active=True, ordered -datetime, server-side. Split into Festivals vs Lab entirely client-side by `type === "festival"` (see src/selectors/festivals.js).

get.summary: List the current user's saved (favourited) events

parameters.name: item_pk
parameters.description: The event's own id, not a saved-relation id — lookup_field='item'.

get.summary: List events/tickets the current user has purchased
get.description: See SignedUpEvent schema — likely serializer/model field mismatch server-side, not currently used by ameba-site. Verify the real response shape before building on this.
"Articles" here means webshop merchandise (t-shirts etc.), not editorial/blog articles — there is no editorial-articles endpoint in this API.
ameba-site's /memberships page assumes a single product and reads element [0].

post.description: Anonymous if unauthenticated (frontend stores the returned id in localStorage as cart_id); attaches to the requesting user if authenticated. This same POST is also reused by the frontend's applyDiscount() with a body of {item_variant_ids, discount_code} — same endpoint/verb serving two different purposes, differentiated only by body shape.

get.summary: Get a cart (use "current" for the logged-in user's cart, get-or-created)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A UUID, or the literal string "current" (requires auth — raises NotAuthenticated if anonymous).

patch.summary: Replace cart contents / set a discount code

item_variant_ids.description: Full replacement list of variant ids — the server clears existing items then re-adds these, it is not a delta/patch of individual items.

405.description: MethodNotAllowed — PUT is explicitly blocked, use PATCH.
MethodNotAllowed — always blocked. Use DELETE /carts/current/ instead (deleteCartAfterSuccesfullCheckout).

get.summary: Create the Stripe PaymentIntent for this cart
get.description: Requires authentication (CartPermission + IsAuthenticated). Despite being a GET, the server-side view validates request.data — double check with real traffic whether this actually needs/accepts a request body in practice.

get.summary: Get the member card for a QR-scanned token

200.description: OK — a single object, not a list

get.summary: Get event-ticket details for a QR-scanned token (marks the ticket checked-in as a side effect)

get.description: Not currently consumed anywhere in ameba-site.
Fetched by ameba-site on every app load (App.jsx) but currently has ZERO consumers — no component reads useDataStore().cover. Dead fetch as of this writing.

Also aliased at GET /manifest/. NOT listed in the DRF router's API-root JSON (it's a bare path(), not a router-registered viewset) — don't be misled by the root view into thinking this endpoint doesn't exist. Currently feeds Manifesto.jsx, which is not rendered by the live Home page (dead consumer as of this writing).

post.summary: Subscribe an email to the default mailing list
post.description: Also not in the router's root JSON (bare path()), but a real, working endpoint — used by the footer newsletter form. Distinct from /subscriptions/ (membership plans) despite the similar name.

get.description: Not currently consumed anywhere in ameba-site.

get.summary: Get "my" member profile (despite being a list endpoint)
get.description: Overridden server-side to just call retrieve() on request.user.member — always returns a single object, never an array, and always the current user's own profile.

parameters.name: pk
parameters.description: IGNORED server-side — get_object() always resolves to request.user's own Member regardless of what's passed here. You can never read someone else's profile through this endpoint.

patch.description: Requires MemberPermission (authenticated AND already has a member profile). If `genres` is present in the body, the server get_or_creates each MusicGenres row by (normalized) name before saving.

get.description: Not currently consumed anywhere in ameba-site (uploads go through members/current/'s upload_images instead). Scoped server-side to request.user.member.

post.description: `member` is auto-injected server-side from the current user — do not send it.
